submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.89 ns among all tested configurations. This configuration was evaluated at three gap widths (1mm: 1.108 ns, 2mm: 0.89 ns, 3mm: 1.021 ns), with the 2mm gap providing optimal performance. Compared to other mixtures at their best gaps, G2 significantly outperforms G1 (1.989 ns) by 55% and G3 (1.315 ns) by 32%. The 2mm gap falls well within the required 1-3mm constraint and represents a practical middle-ground configuration that should be manufacturable and stable in operation. This recommendation directly fulfills the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution while meeting all specified constraints.
